android.desc:
CarriFit is the AI calorie counter built to help you reach your goals with less effort. Track calories, macros, weight, water, and daily progress in one app designed to make food logging faster and staying consistent easier.

Whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, improve your nutrition, or stay on top of your fitness routine, CarriFit helps you spend less time logging and more time following through.

Log meals faster
Traditional calorie tracking can feel slow and frustrating. CarriFit gives you faster ways to log what you eat so you can stay on track, even on busy days.

Track food your way
Use the method that works best for you:

* Take a photo of your meal
* Say what you ate with voice logging
* Search foods quickly
* Scan barcodes on packaged items

AI photo logging
Take a picture of your meal and get fast estimates for calories, macros, and portion details. It is a simpler way to track food without typing everything manually.

Voice food logging
Just say what you ate and CarriFit helps turn it into a food log. Voice logging makes calorie tracking feel easier when you are on the go.

Calorie and macro tracking
See your calorie target, remaining calories, and macro breakdown in one place. Track protein, carbs, and fat clearly so you can make better decisions throughout the day.

Track more than food
CarriFit helps you stay on top of the bigger picture with tools for:

* Weight tracking
* Workouts synced from Health Connect
* Calories burned
* Water intake
* Daily steps
* Progress over time

Built for consistency
The best nutrition app is the one you can keep using. CarriFit is designed to reduce friction so you can keep tracking, stay aware of your habits, and continue making progress.

Progress that keeps you moving
View your weight trend, streaks, daily adherence, and overall progress with clear insights that help you stay focused on your goals.

Use CarriFit to:

* Lose weight
* Gain muscle
* Track macros
* Build better eating habits
* Stay consistent with nutrition and fitness
* Follow your progress with more clarity

If you want an AI calorie counter that makes tracking feel faster, simpler, and easier to stick with, CarriFit gives you the tools to stay on track and keep improving.

Download CarriFit and start tracking smarter.
